prompts.tiger_run: Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite sheet, transparent background. Korean Joseon minhwa tiger, ochre orange, black ink stripes, cream muzzle, whimsical fierce face, delicate traditional brush textures matching a Korean ink mountain collage game. EXACTLY FIVE full-body animation poses of the SAME tiger running/pouncing toward the RIGHT. Grid is EXACTLY 3 columns x 2 rows equal cells: top row poses 1,2,3; bottom row poses 4,5; bottom right cell completely EMPTY transparent. Wide landscape canvas 1536x1024. Each tiger stays completely inside its own 512x512 cell with at least 55 pixels clear padding on every side, tails never cross cell borders. Same body scale and feet baseline in every cell. Five distinct sequential run-cycle poses: crouch anticipation, push-off, extended airborne, forepaw landing, hindleg recovery. No scenery, no floor, no shadows outside animals, no grid lines, no labels, no text.
